scope: Checked-in selected corpus and authored assets; counts do not establish editorial quality or runtime availability.
selection: The original 1,000-word corpus, followed by 251 missing normalized entries from the supplied HSK 1–4 workbook in level and row order. Existing words and lesson order are preserved.

editorial.independentReviewEvidence: No independent reviewer records in the compiled corpus; element-review files are source/gloss worklists, not review verdicts.
editorial.learningEffectiveness: Not measured by this audit; draft story presence is not evidence of memorability or cultural accuracy.

authoredScenes.story: With a few trees—two—you can start collecting wood.
With many trees—three—we have a forest.
“Please” is a polite, green way of talking.
The machine often held in your hand is the handphone.
A brain powered by electricity is a computer. It thinks and gives other robots their commands.
A girl and a boy in one family: a good combination in this Chinese family mnemonic.
authoredScenes.interpretation: The girl-and-boy family scene is a learning mnemonic, not a historical derivation or a universal claim about Chinese families. Source component readings remain woman and child.
